title: Tina out guide was...
text:
Tina out guide was remarkable..she shared her experience and knowledge with us and had a wonderful sense of humor. The driver was very professional. 
I would recommend this tour to everyone. We saw so much that it was when we were looking at the pictures afterwards we realized just how much we had seen.
author: JudithE_R

title: Driver was on time with name sign...
text: Driver was on time with name sign. Vehicle in excellent condition
author: matt.dobeck

title: Great tour of Barcelona. Sonya did a...
text: Great tour of Barcelona. Sonya did a terrific job. We were very satisfied.
author: Stephen K

title: Our guide Sonia and driver Jordi...
text: Our guide Sonia and driver Jordi were outstanding. We were able to experience virtually all of Barcelona by a great mix of walking tours and riding. We experienced and saw so much of Barcelona in this one day that there was only a small amount of sightseeing we needed to see the next day.
author: vernon_T

title: Outstanding day spent with Babbita...
text: Outstanding day spent with Babbita and our driver Christian. Cannot recommend this trip highly enough. Myself and my wife enjoyed it immensely. We felt like royalty! Barcelona is stunning and this has to be one of the best ways to see it. Thanks again to our hosts!!
author: Morag E

title: Drive and guide were outstanding...
text: Drive and guide were outstanding their knowledge of their beautiful city was exceptional. Their professionalism and personalities made for a very informative and enjoyable day.
author: Michael K

title: I really enjoyed the private tour...
text: I really enjoyed the private tour and having a driver along with the guide since my wife is handicapped. Tailored perfectly and would recommend to others.
author: Joseph R

title: The all day private tour of...
text: The all day private tour of Barcelona was exceptional. Our guide, Sandra, was the best. There were six of us and she tailored the tour perfectly to suit our interests when we explained at the beginning of the day what it was we wanted to see and do. The sights were phenominal and her knowledge was extensive.
author: Linda B

title: What a day with Susanna!  She was...
text: What a day with Susanna! She was delightful, very bright and has an enormous depth of knowledge on all subjects. Very good driver who took us to all the places we wanted to see and that she suggested, a very good team. Susanna has a wonderful sense of humor and sensibility which added greatly to our all day tour. She joined us for lunch and introduced us to 'pinchos', which we loved. It was obvious that she is very proud of Barcelona and her heritage.
author: Jill B

title: Guide was great and very...
text: Guide was great and very knowledgeable about what we saw and where she took us as we wanted an overview of the city and the must see things. I think for those who have a more specific wish list they would be satisfied also.
author: John F
